Package me.manossef.api.alexandria

Class TypeChecks

  • java.lang.Object
    • me.manossef.api.alexandria.TypeChecks
  • public final class TypeChecks
extends java.lang.Object
    Contains utility methods for checking whether a string can be safely converted to other types.

    • Method Summary

      All Methods Static Methods Concrete Methods 
      Modifier and Type Method Description
      static boolean isBoolean​(java.lang.String input)
      Returns true if the specified string is equal to either "true" or "false", and false otherwise.
      static boolean isByte​(java.lang.String input)
      Returns true if the specified string can be safely converted to a byte (as if by Byte.parseByte(String)), and false otherwise.
      static boolean isDouble​(java.lang.String input)
      Returns true if the specified string can be safely converted to a double (as if by Double.parseDouble(String)), and false otherwise.
      static <T extends java.lang.Enum<T>>
      boolean      		 isEnum​(java.lang.String input, java.lang.Class<T> clazz)
      Returns true if the specified string exactly matches one of the enum constants declared in the specified enum class, and false otherwise.
      static boolean isFloat​(java.lang.String input)
      Returns true if the specified string can be safely converted to a float (as if by Float.parseFloat(String)), and false otherwise.
      static boolean isInt​(java.lang.String input)
      Returns true if the specified string can be safely converted to an int (as if by Integer.parseInt(String)), and false otherwise.
      static boolean isLong​(java.lang.String input)
      Returns true if the specified string can be safely converted to a long (as if by Long.parseLong(String)), and false otherwise.
      static boolean isShort​(java.lang.String input)
      Returns true if the specified string can be safely converted to a short (as if by Short.parseShort(String)), and false otherwise.
      static boolean isUUID​(java.lang.String input)
      Returns true if the specified string describes a UUID in its standard string representation, and false otherwise.

      • isEnum

        public static <T extends java.lang.Enum<T>> boolean isEnum​(java.lang.String input,
                                                           java.lang.Class<T> clazz)
        Returns true if the specified string exactly matches one of the enum constants declared in the specified enum class, and false otherwise. If the specified class is not an enum, this method always returns false.
        Type Parameters:
        T - The enum type.
        Parameters:
        input - The string to check.
        clazz - The enum class to check against.
        Returns:
        true if the string exactly matches one of the specified enum's constants, and false otherwise.
